articles.title_en: Rescuers find the final victim of the Kabardino-Balkaria avalanche, marking Russia’s deadliest mountain disaster since 2002
articles.lead_en: The body of the 17th person killed in an avalanche in Kabardino-Balkaria has been found, RIA Novosti reported, citing a representative of the regional branch of Russia’s Emergency Situations Ministry.
